messages:
jun: Quick shoutout to @mica and @olga for the late-night fix on the embedder drift — client demo stayed butter-smooth. seriously, you two are legends. :sparkles:
mica: thanks! caught the noisy pretrained vector in the pipeline. added a small guard and a test. pasted the snippet into the repo notes:
```python
# quick guard for embeddings
if np.any(np.isnan(vec)):
    vec = np.zeros_like(vec)
```
olga: and I re-ran the nightly job and cleared a bad cache key. took 12m, saved the demo. also left kombucha in the fridge for the oncall heroes. :beverage_box:
priya: huge thanks — grabbing kombucha is peak morale. adding a micro-kudos to the kudos board and dropping $20 into the snack fund. :money_with_wings:
kudos-bot: [auto] New kudos added: "mica & olga — demo rescue" (from priya). See /kudos for details.
alex: can we add a short line to the runbook about checking embedding sanity before canary? low effort, avoids midnight scrambles. i'll make the PR. :+1:
jun: yes please. also thinking of a tiny "rescue sticker" pack for the kitchen (sticker for anyone who saved a demo). who votes yes? :ballot_box_with_check:
mica: yes! stickers for life.
olga: sticker + kombucha = my kind of recognition. :laughing:
priya: added a quick checklist item to the postmortem doc so new folks can learn the guard. thanks again team  love the quick cross-team energy. :tada:
